## Overview
### Introduction to Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B
The Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B model, provided by Alibaba Cloud, is a mid-tier open-source language model released on 2024-11-11. This model is specifically designed with a focus on coding capabilities, making it an ideal choice for developers. The architecture of Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B supports a context window of 32,768 tokens and can generate output up to 8,192 tokens. With its knowledge cutoff in 2024-05, it ensures that the information provided is up to date until that point.

### Technical Capabilities and Pricing
Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B boasts impressive technical capabilities, including support for text, code, streaming, system prompts, and function calling. Its strengths are reflected in benchmark scores such as MMLU (83.2), HumanEval (92.7), LMSYS Arena ELO (1210), and GSM8K (91.6). The pricing model for this service is based on input and output tokens, with costs set at $0.8 per 1M input tokens and $1.5 per 1M output tokens. For example, 1,000 calls averaging 500 tokens each would cost approximately $0.575. This competitive pricing, especially when compared to models like GPT-4o which charges $2.5/1M input and $10.0/1M output, makes Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B an attractive option for coding tasks.
